guidance: The deliverable is a research report and its companion files, written from primary sources archived beside it. Verdicts and output format follow references/verdicts.md. Sweep semantically for prescription-detected sentences — the report presents facts and how they connect, never recommendations to an actor. One institutional publisher counts as one primary source; flag claims that inflate the source count.
note: Layout assumed: one folder per entry, holding the report, a README, dated atomic notes, an evidence file, an archived sources/ directory and a changelog/ for audit output. Edit the globs if your workspace differs. Reach for this preset when a report is long enough that a single reader would degrade; for a handful of claims, one agent reading the report against the sources is cheaper.
